description: Read-only baseline: repository AGENTS.md size (as committed on the Phase 0 branch HEAD; content identical to origin/main — Phase-0 commits do not modify AGENTS.md) and resolved CLI toolsets per Hermes profile. Phase 0 report assembly input.

repository.branch: Phase 0 baseline branch (AGENTS.md identical to origin/main)
repository.head_subject: docs(audits): regenerate Phase 0 baseline on current origin/main — neutral provenance, fresh AGENTS.md facts, no task/worktree identifiers

agents_md.path: AGENTS.md (repo root, as committed on HEAD — git show HEAD:AGENTS.md, never the working tree)
agents_md.measurement_method: git show HEAD:AGENTS.md -> decode utf-8; lines = text.splitlines() count; wc -l agrees. Note: len(text.split('\n')) would be lines+1 (trailing empty element after final newline).

cli_toolsets.resolve_method: hermes_cli.kanban_db._resolve_worker_cli_toolsets(<profile_dir>) with Windows paths (MSYS paths silently fail config load), HERMES_HOME set to each profile dir
cli_toolsets.resolve_source: profile config.yaml platform_toolsets.cli (explicit list, no hermes-cli composite) + agent.disabled_toolsets (drops bfl via _enable_recently_shipped_toolsets subtraction)

non_goals: No toolsets, config.yaml, AGENTS.md, or profile settings were changed
No pipeline / llama-server / book / chapter runs started
No tracked config or production files changed (only tools/context_baseline.json and Phase 0 report/evidence added)
